scope: Existing public website and released customer-app shared code; private V3 untouched
changes: Account, Orders, Rewards, Subscriptions and CreditWallet share one full identity-resolved in-memory dashboard query; observers select their own fields.
30-second navigation freshness with explicit refresh, active-order polling, principal-scoped cache replacement and targeted invalidation after relevant writes.
Invalidation cancels old in-flight reads before marking stale; checkout entry marks stale without fetching, exit refreshes any already-mounted destination.
Five independent backend read sections start after unchanged authentication and identity resolution. Traversal, limits, filters, response shape and error precedence remain unchanged.

Website product detail can reuse a fresh matching actual catalog item; cache misses retain the prior 200-item lookup and ID fallback. Static fallback records and missing results do not become authoritative fresh data. Native product lookup is unchanged.
Static Connect and Subscribe pages no longer wait for web auth; native, callback, protected and onboarding boundaries remain enforced.
Cancelled-only subscriptions show the existing no-active-subscriptions state; failures show retry guidance. A checkout URL no longer claims payment was received.

local_verification.backend_parity: 19 synthetic baseline-versus-candidate scenarios; no real customer reads or writes
local_verification.backend_timing: Deterministic simulated critical paths 255 to 145 and 590 to 305 logical milliseconds; NOT live latency estimates
local_verification.query_tests: Real TanStack QueryObservers verify reuse, refresh, in-flight cancellation, raw selectors, polling, denial and principal retirement
local_verification.browser_smoke: Chrome, loopback-only built candidate: Shop to AURA, Connect, Subscribe. Historical local catalog only; CSP blocks external traffic; writes/functions denied. Not an authenticated or native-device test.
local_verification.manifest_algorithm: sha256(JSON.stringify({path,bytes,sha256} records sorted by relative path with localeCompare en))

release_boundaries.website: Requires approved exact source, CI, preserved rollback and action-time publish approval. Website publication does not update installed apps.
release_boundaries.backend: Requires fresh deployed gateway source parity, scoped change review and approval. The gateway bundles other actions; do not deploy unrelated repository functions or overwrite unverified live differences.
release_boundaries.installed_apps: Current source and archived released binaries explicitly sync Appflow app 044c03e1 Production at startup/resume. Verify current active source/snapshot, compatibility and separate iOS/Android smoke tests before an approved OTA promotion. No native plugin/config changes are included.

remaining_performance_work: Re-measure cold HTML/server response and exact slow gateway actions after separately approved scoped releases; the frontend cannot remove hosting/provider response latency.
Authenticated browser and physical iOS/Android timing and functional checks remain required. Local query tests and archived native source are not current installed-device proof.
Investigate remaining large hero images and unconditional homepage preload without changing artwork/crops or delaying homepage image discovery.
Do not claim instant performance, Google ranking improvement or passing field Core Web Vitals from synthetic or single local observations.
